fields.summary: PUT /api/items/{id} accepts negative and over-limit quantity
fields.description:
h3. Problem
Creating an item rejects quantity < 0 or > 100000, but updating one does not. We found an item with quantity -5 in production.

h3. Expected
PUT applies the same quantity rules as POST and returns 400 with {"error": "..."}.

h3. Acceptance criteria
* PUT with quantity -1 returns 400
* PUT with quantity 100001 returns 400
* PUT with quantity 0 and 100000 still succeeds
* The error text is the same as for POST

comments.body: Seen on two items so far. Not urgent for the pickers, but the purchasing sheet breaks.
